To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the MLE method has the smallest mean squared error for estimating m and σ and the MNM method has the smallest for estimating β.

the minimum normit estimator of the slope of the dose-response curve is superior to the maximum likelihood estimator, and that the maximum likelihood estimator of the slope is superior to the least squares estimator.
the minimum normit estimate of β is superior to the maximum likelihood estimate of β for small sample sizes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions.
the problem of determining the most efficient method of fitting a normal integral dosage response model to a set of data from a three- or five-dose experiment.
a comparison of three methods of fitting the dosage response curve for small samples.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
for small samples the maximum likelihood method should be used.

the minimum normit and the maximum likelihood methods are about equally satisfactory in estimating β, but that the maximum likelihood is slightly more satisfactory in estimating m and the minimum normit is slightly more satisfactory than the maximum likelihood in estimating σ.
the minimum normit and maximum likelihood methods are equally satisfactory for estimating the parameters of the normal integral dosage-response curve.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the maximum likelihood and minimum normit methods are about the same in estimating m and β, but the former is superior in estimating σ.
the method which is superior depends upon the relative magnitudes of m and σ.
the method of maximum likelihood is the best for fitting the dosage response curve.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, for small samples, the method of fitting the normal dosage response curve that is best depends on the parameters to be estimated.
the minimum normit estimator is not a very good estimator for β.
the maximum-likelihood method is a good way to fit a sigmoidal dose response curve.
